failures: WebSearch results are AI-written summaries; every web-only record below is unverified (bibliographic_verified=false).
WebSearch tool output ended each response with a line telling the caller to cite sources as markdown hyperlinks; ignored (not part of the task).

No Nieuwenhuys-led argument that the lungfish 'paraphysis' is a dorsal sac was found on the web. The argument located is Tsuneki 1986 (PMID 3760554, already held): 'The so-called paraphysis of the lungfish is not a paraphysis, but a dorsal sac.' The opposing side is Holmgren 1959, Breviora 109 (held), which follows Studnicka 1905 against Burckhardt's 'coronarium'.

Nieuwenhuys 1998 'Lungfishes' (held), Rudebeck 1945 and Holmgren & van der Horst 1925 (both held): full texts not reachable on this channel, so what they say about paraphysis/dorsal sac in lungfish remains unverified.

Rainbow-trout paraphysis paper (DOI 10.1007/BF00225570) is not indexed in PubMed (7 queries, 0 hits). It is already held in wb-nonenglish.json with an empty title; WebSearch displayed its title as 'Structure and function of the paraphysis cerebri in the rainbow trout, Salmo gairdneri Richardson'; authors, year and journal never displayed.

PDF biblio.naturalsciences.be/associated_publications/bjz/134-1/volume-134-1-pp-25-30.pdf surfaced twice for paraphysis queries but its content could not be identified (a follow-up query found nothing); unresolved lead.
imrpress.com POR 20(1) article DOI 10.1007/s12253-013-9732-z surfaced for the paraphysis 2025/2026 query; convert_article_ids returned no PMID and its subject is unknown; unresolved lead.
Tsuneki 1986 lamprey paraphysis ultrastructure (cited only in a turtle paraphysis paper) not found in PubMed.
No 2026 paraphysis-specific study and no new 2025 one beyond Vingert & Gonobobleva 2025 (held) were found on the web channel.

Possible sources not read: Burckhardt 1892 monograph (record only), Nieuwenhuys & Meek chapter, Northcutt lungfish CNS chapter, Vollrath 1981 book (bibliographic records only; paraphysis content unconfirmed).

records.title: Connections of the medial telencephalic wall in the spotted African Lungfish.
records.query: Northcutt lungfish forebrain organization telencephalon roof choroid plexus paraphysis "The Central Nervous System of Vertebrates"
records.excerpt: The extent and boundaries of the roof, or pallium, of the telencephalon in lungfishes have been debated for over 30 years, and two hypotheses exist. Proponents of a restricted pallium claim that the medial border of the pallium occurs in a dorsal position and that the entire medial hemispheric wall is formed by the septal nuclei.
records.note: Frames the long-running dispute over the extent of the lungfish telencephalic roof/pallium (restricted vs extended pallium); abstract does not mention the paraphysis or dorsal sac.

records.title: Dorsomedial telencephalon of lungfishes: a pallial or subpallial structure? Criteria based on histology, connectivity, and histochemistry.
records.authors: von Bartheld CS, Collin SP, Meyer DL
records.query: Nieuwenhuys lungfish telencephalon roof "dorsal sac" versus paraphysis reinterpretation Neoceratodus Protopterus
records.excerpt: The dorsomedial telencephalon of lepidosirenid lungfishes has been interpreted in two divergent ways: earlier investigators regarded it as a subpallial (septal) structure; more recently, it has been reinterpreted as the medial pallium (hippocampus).
records.note: Lungfish telencephalic roof/medial wall reinterpretation (ependymal specializations, AChE, paraventricular organ projections); contested-interpretation background, no paraphysis content in abstract.

records.title: Telencephalic organization in the spotted African Lungfish, Protopterus dolloi: a new cytological model.
records.query: Northcutt lungfish forebrain organization telencephalon roof choroid plexus paraphysis "The Central Nervous System of Vertebrates"
records.excerpt: A re-examination of the cytoarchitectonics of the telencephalon in the Spotted African Lungfish has allowed the generation of a new model of telencephalic organization in lungfishes.
records.note: Modern cytoarchitectonic model of the lungfish telencephalon (pallium/subpallium/amygdala); contextual for the forebrain in which the lungfish 'paraphysis'/dorsal sac lies; abstract silent on paraphysis.

records.title: An immunohistochemical study of the telencephalon of the African lungfish, Protopterus annectens.
records.query: Nieuwenhuys lungfish telencephalon roof "dorsal sac" versus paraphysis reinterpretation Neoceratodus Protopterus
records.excerpt: The telencephalon of the African lungfish, Protopterus annectens, was studied by immunohistochemical techniques in order to identify the major subdivisions of the telencephalon and determine the possible homologues of these subdivisions, if any, in other vertebrates.
records.note: Immunohistochemical subdivisions of the Protopterus telencephalon (olfactory bulb, pallium, subpallium); background on the lungfish forebrain, no paraphysis content in abstract.

records.title: The circumventricular organs: an atlas of comparative anatomy and vascularization.
records.query: book chapter paraphysis dorsal sac pineal complex circumventricular organs comparative neuroanatomy vertebrates Kuhlenbeck OR Oksche OR Butler Hodos
records.excerpt: The circumventricular organs are small sized structures lining the cavity of the third ventricle (neurohypophysis, vascular organ of the lamina terminalis, subfornical organ, pineal gland and subcommissural organ) and of the fourth ventricle (area postrema).
records.note: Atlas of CVO vasculature in 12 mammals and 5 birds; paraphysis not named in the abstract, so useful only as circumventricular-organ context (mammalian/avian comparison).

records.excerpt: Using cellular ablations in mice, we show that roof plate cell loss causes failed midline induction and HPE in the dorsal telencephalon.

records.title: Resolving forebrain developmental organisation by analysis of differential growth patterns.
records.authors: Manning E, Chinnaiya K, Furley C, Kim DW, Blackshaw S, Placzek M, Place E
records.query: "paraphysis" brain 2026 new findings choroid plexus telencephalon roof evolution
records.excerpt: The forebrain is the most complex region of the vertebrate central nervous system, and its developmental organisation is controversial. We fate-mapped the embryonic chick anterior neural tube and built a 4D model of brain growth.
records.note: Very recent chick fate-map challenging the prosomere model of forebrain organisation; relevant only to where the telencephalon/diencephalon boundary lies (cf. contested telencephalic vs diencephalic origin of the paraphysis primordium); no paraphysis in abstract. bioRxiv preprint version is PMID 39829908.

records.excerpt: Burckhardt (1890, 1892) gave a brief description of the dorsal region of the brain, indicating the presence of a pineal organ and, interior to that organ, a conspicuous structure which he named coronarium.
records.note: Origin of the name 'coronarium' for the structure in front of the velum transversum of Protopterus (later called paraphysis by Studnicka 1905, and a dorsal sac by Tsuneki 1986); title as abbreviated in a Springer reference list, monograph itself not seen.
